Discover this elegant property, situated in a prime location just minutes from amenities, schools, and the train station.

Located on the ground floor, it was designed to offer functionality and comfort.

It also features a private outdoor parking space and an excellent terrace with a laundry area.

Equipped with electric blinds, pre-installation for air conditioning and a heat pump, it ensures efficiency and modernity.
